prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic wide urban portrait of an approved adult man seated thoughtfully on a concrete ledge.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man wearing a dark sweater with a distinctive light graphic pattern, olive-green pants, and black sneakers. He sits centered on the ledge with hands clasped and looks to his right.
prompt.composition_elements: Wide vertical shot with modern grey tiled apartment building, concrete ledge, walkway, and clear immediate background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight with soft shadows, realistic knit, pants, skin, concrete, and building texture, calm introspective street mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical environmental portrait, clear focus on subject and nearby background, natural color and proportions.
